⚔️ Sword Trial

A VR sword-fighting scene. Open this page on your Quest's browser, tap Enter VR, squeeze grip to grab weapons, swing to fight. Watch the enemy's wind-up — get your blade or shield in front of you to block, or swing into the strike to parry. Hold a blade steady to block, or swing into an attack to parry (staggers the foe). Raise a shield in front of you to guard. Left Y = character / equips. Right B = weapon list. With a staff: trigger fires spells, right B cycles them. Head into the dungeon — enemies chase once they spot you.

MULTIPLAYER (presence + always-on voice)

Skeleton Health: 100%
